author_boundary: Independent read-only source reviewer, not verifier/profile author. Wrote this report and separate synthetic/in-memory checks only.

findings.fact: After retaining exactly one file-backed full-cover segment,002 iterates all other outer segments and rejects each nonempty vmsize extent intersecting the consumed half-open range. It uses full VM extent rather than filesize, so strict interior, partial head/tail, pure zero-fill and zero-fill-tail shadows refuse. Empty ranges and exact adjacency do not intersect. Existing header scalar bounds ensure VM extents do not wrap. This is the sole production source change.

The new check applies to the embedded header, full executable segment and every target section. Prior bounded ARM64/MH_FILESET parsing, unique kernel member/UUID, exact source-profile VAs/sizes/protections/flags/section metadata, absolute KC offsets, section-fileoff formula and full code/text hashes remain unchanged. No member-base addition or signature occurrence count is introduced.

Production accepts immutable bytes only and loads the sole adjacent profile whose unchangedc4ab hash is embedded and checked each call. Public caller profile injection remains absent; private _verify(raw,profile) remains a trusted synthetic-test interface, not a sandbox against privileged Python mutation. Caller must hash-bind module source as well.

Replayed the original reviewer exact4KiB mutation (image SHAfc8651a8...) and root exact16KiB72-byte command/header-count plan (image SHA4a149b41...). Both now refuse with additional intersecting outer VM mapping. Healthy unchangedaf9 still matches; ordinary first/last executable-bit changes and all five actual shadow controls refuse. These are generated in-memory parser checks, not loader/runtime execution.

16 current compiled Python mutants are assertion-killed without test errors. One prior section-shadow mutant was removed because the stronger whole-segment all-intersection guard now independently rejects that scenario; section mapping/absolute-offset checks remain in source. Three new mutations test omitted, filesize-only and full-cover-only intersection logic. This does not convert001 into an approved source.

limits: Approved only as a compiled main executable-code ABI profile verifier. It does not authenticate other KC members/data/fixups/signatures, a loader execution or loaded kernel identity.
Coherent file-only relocation can pass with exact same trusted VM/code profile; whole-image SHA remains a fresh returned binding and does not inherit prior packet/hardware admission.
No final guest BootArgs bytes/value, allocation identity, source field provenance, write ordering or prior runtime failure cause is established.

Future isolated host/controller integration must bind exact002 module/profile/source hashes and verify the actual selected immutable KC bytes before any separately authorized reboot; this source review adds no writer or boot permission.
